keyFindings.description: Main's #2423 (merged in 402c06ae) makes the rule: 'A pull request never commits dist/ or legion/' (packages/claude-envoy/AGENTS.md:151). A pull request that already carries such changes drops them at its next merge of main, and a reviewer asks for that (:159-163). The branch still changes each of the three bundles by 266 lines against main. Main's rebuild workflow commits these files after each merge, so every rebuild before this pull request lands is a new conflict on generated files. No CI check compares the committed bundle with a build. If kept, the plugin bytes on main change at the merge, not at the rebuild, so the rebuild has nothing to push and the production check has no rebuild commit to name. Fix: in a new commit, jj restore --from main@origin packages/claude-envoy/dist packages/claude-envoy/legion.
'so dist/ is rebuilt in the same change' contradicts the new rule. The changes reach Claude Code with main's rebuild after the merge.
'since dist/ was regenerated' becomes false once dist is dropped. Say main's rebuild carries the new bundle.
